seeded_draw_procedure: random.Random(seed); for each family group in sorted order, rng.sample(sorted(frame tags in that group), min(3, size)); frame = official tags with original 15-task score >= 9, minus the 23 tuning configs in the census, minus the first-version 10 (and, for round two, minus round one)

v1_randomization_diagnostic.caveat: size cut-off read off the sample (post hoc); a diagnostic, not a pre-planned test
